dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned loops featuring sharp gradient transitions from a dark gray exterior to a lighter interior; edges exhibit high spatial frequency variance and non-uniform thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized along the lower-lateral margins and interspersed between larger ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-body macro-annuli form a wide-angle obtuse triangle, while adjacent high-intensity blobs create a series of smaller, irregular polygons along the longitudinal axis.
